result: {"findings":[{"severity":"warning","path":"spec.md","line":4,"quote":"Users must email support to close an account; add `DELETE /accounts/{id}` and a button in settings.","claim":"The spec defines `DELETE /accounts/{id}` but never says what happens when the session user is not the owner of `{id}`, and the acceptance criteria cover only the owner, wrong-password and anonymous cases.","reproduce":""},{"severity":"warning","path":"spec.md","line":12,"quote":"- Deletion sets the existing `closed_at` column at once, and the existing retention job, which already erases accounts closed for 30 days, erases its data.","claim":"The spec does not say whether sessions are revoked or login is blocked once `closed_at` is set, so a closed account may stay usable during the 30-day window.","reproduce":""}]}
